<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="content_css"><content_css action="DELETE"><name>global_update_set_studio</name><style>    :root {
      --bg: #111827;
      --panel: #1f2937;
      --panel-2: #0f172a;
      --text: #e5e7eb;
      --muted: #9ca3af;
      --border: #374151;
      --hover: #243244;
      --selected: #1e3a5f;
      --warning-bg: #3f2a12;
      --warning-border: #7c4a13;
      --warning-text: #fcd9a3;
    }

    * { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; font-family: Inter, Arial, sans-serif; background: var(--bg); color: var(--text); }

    .guss-app { display: grid; grid-template-columns: var(--guss-sidebar-width, 330px) 6px 1fr; height: 100vh; }
    .guss-sidebar { border-right: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--panel-2); overflow: auto; position: relative; }
    .guss-resizer { background: #1f2937; border-right: 1px solid var(--border); cursor: ew-resize; position: relative; }
    .guss-resizer:hover { background: #334155; }
    .guss-resizer::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 2px; top: 50%; width: 2px; height: 48px; transform: translateY(-50%); background: rgba(148,163,184,0.75); border-radius: 1px; }
    .guss-sidebar-head { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; padding: 12px 12px 8px; position: sticky; top: 0; background: var(--panel-2); z-index: 5; }
    .guss-add-btn { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.25); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: #ffffff; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.08); }
    .guss-add-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); }
    .guss-add-menu { position: absolute; top: 62px; right: 12px; width: 290px; background: #ffffff; color: #334155; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.28); border: 1px solid #d9e2ec; overflow: hidden; z-index: 20; }
    .guss-add-menu-title { padding: 12px 16px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #94a3b8; text-transform: uppercase; border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; }
    .guss-add-menu-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:100%; border:0; background:#ffffff; color:#334155; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 13px; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; }
    .guss-add-menu-item:hover { background:#f8fafc; }
    .guss-add-menu-icon { width: 20px; text-align:center; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; }
    .guss-main { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 48px 1fr; min-width: 0; min-height: 0; }
    .guss-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; padding: 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--panel); }
    .guss-title { font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.2px; }
    .guss-topbar-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
    .guss-meta { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; white-space: nowrap; }
    .guss-btn { border: 1px solid var(--border); background: #0b1220; color: var(--text); border-radius: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; font-size: 12px; cursor: pointer; }
    .guss-btn:hover { background: #172033; }

    .guss-workspace { display: grid; grid-template-rows: 1fr; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    .guss-tabs {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      gap: 2px;
      padding: 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #bcc7d5;
      background: #dde4ec;
      overflow-x: auto;
    }

    .guss-tab {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      margin-top: 0;
      padding: 16px 14px 13px;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      border-bottom: none;
      border-top-left-radius: 14px;
      border-top-right-radius: 14px;
      background: #d5dde7;
      color: #5b6f87;
      cursor: pointer;
      white-space: nowrap;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1;
      position: relative;
      top: -1px;
    }

    .guss-tab.active {
      background: #ffffff;
      color: #0f4f79;
      border-color: #b8c5d4;
      box-shadow: inset 0 3px 0 #1ea6ff;
      font-weight: 600;
    }

    .guss-tab-label { max-width: 230px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
    .guss-tab-close { color: #8a99ac; font-weight: 600; font-size: 22px; line-height: 12px; margin-left: 2px; }

    .guss-viewer { min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    .guss-iframe { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: 0; background: #fff; }
    .guss-empty { height: 100%; padding: 16px; overflow: auto; }
    .guss-empty-intro { text-align: center; }
    .guss-empty-title { font-size: 56px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; color: #e5e7eb; letter-spacing: 1px; }
    .guss-empty-subtitle { margin-top: 12px; font-size: 20px; color: #9ca3af; }
    .guss-empty-divider { width: 220px; height: 1px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.55), transparent); margin: 16px auto 0; }
    .guss-empty-meta { margin: 16px auto 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 150px minmax(280px, 1fr); gap: 12px 16px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: min(100%, 920px); max-width: 920px; }
    .guss-empty-label { font-size: 18px; color: #cbd5e1; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; }
    .guss-empty-value { font-size: 18px; color: #cbd5e1; text-align: left; }
.guss-empty-note { display: block; width: min(100%, 600px); margin: 20px auto 0; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(20, 184, 166, 0.45); background: rgba(13, 148, 136, 0.18); color: #99f6e4; font-size: 14px; font-style: italic; line-height: 1.5; text-align: center; }
    .guss-empty-select { width: 100%; padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid #94a3b8; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #eef3f8 100%); color: #0f172a; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); }
    .guss-empty-select:focus { outline: none; border-color: #60a5fa; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(59, 130, 246, 0.25), 0 8px 20px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.18), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.95); }
    .guss-empty-select:disabled { opacity: 0.7; cursor: default; }
    .guss-empty-action-cell { width: min(100%, 920px); max-width: 920px; margin: 12px auto 0; display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; }
    .guss-empty-action { padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #60a5fa; border-radius: 10px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #dbeafe 0%, #bfdbfe 100%); color: #0f172a; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.12); }
    .guss-empty-action:hover { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #bfdbfe 0%, #93c5fd 100%); }
    .guss-loading-wrap { height: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
    .guss-loading { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 14px; color: #cbd5e1; }
    .guss-spinner { width: 42px; height: 42px; border-radius: 50%; border: 4px solid rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.28); border-top-color: #93c5fd; animation: guss-spin 0.9s linear infinite; }
    .guss-loading-text { font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; color: #94a3b8; }
    @keyframes guss-spin { from { transform: rotate(0deg); } to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
    .guss-panel { background: #0b1220; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 14px; }
    .guss-muted { color: var(--muted); }
    .guss-notice { margin: 8px 12px 0; border: 1px solid var(--warning-border); background: var(--warning-bg); color: var(--warning-text); border-radius: 6px; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 12px; display: none; }

    .guss-section-title { padding: 12px 12px 8px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; }
    .guss-tree { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 8px 16px; }
    .guss-node { margin: 1px 0; }
    .guss-node-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 6px 8px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; }
    .guss-node-row:hover { background: var(--hover); }
    .guss-node-row.guss-selected { background: var(--selected); }
    .guss-caret { width: 10px; color: var(--muted); flex: 0 0 10px; text-align: center; }
    .guss-name { flex: 1; font-size: 12px; min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
    .guss-children { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 0 22px; }
    .guss-file-icon { color: #93c5fd; }
    .guss-folder-icon { color: #fbbf24; }
